test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 14 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Mother was tired, _______ she stayed up all night.
solution:
The correct answer is '**yet**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the first clause and second clause are contradictory statements. So we need conjunction here to link them.
 
• Yet is an adverb and it can also be used as a conjunction. &
